items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1958-Fall
items.q: Well, Johnny could have met him then. But he certainly did. He wrote that in 1918, Johnny did the original.

ctx.x: I don't know whether Freddie Moore was around at that time, it was a little bit later, he played with Oliver, recorded with Oliver. Did he?

Well, Johnny could have met him then. But he certainly did. He wrote that in 1918, Johnny did the original. Oh, did he? That's a little bit of Freddie Moore. Yeah. But, anyhow, it's a funny thing now, there's some park or something in England by the name of Frogmore. Oh, really? Yes, F-R-O-G-M-O-R-E, I ran across that. I started to write a little squib about that, say the telly room was honoring the Queen, Queen Victoria, I don't know, it couldn't have been Queen Victoria, it was too late for her.
Did you get in, when you were in New Orleans, did you get into any of those dance halls down there? Well, I used to look in on them.
